_meta.title: Early Career Medical Research Grants Database
_meta.description: Grant opportunities for medical residents, fellows, postdocs, and early faculty. Broad coverage across specialties with emphasis on anesthesia.
_meta.notes: Deadlines and amounts change annually — verify with each funder before applying. v2.0: removed non-US programs; added UCSF RAP grants. v2.1.0 (2026-05-26): added ABA/FAER REG, FAER TIG, PhRMA Faculty Starter, Doris Duke CSDA, Parker B. Francis. v2.2.0 (2026-05-26): renamed 'Graduate Medical Education' → 'Medical Education Research'; added ABMS REF Grant, SAEM ERTG, AAMC GEA National Grant. v2.3.0 (2026-11-13): monthly check fixes: 14 URLs updated (Lilly IIR, FAER RFG/MRTG, Merck MISP, Takeda, UCSF Catalyst, NIBIB, etc.); 12 passed deadlines updated to next cycle; 10 upcoming deadlines marked soon; removed 6 discontinued: epa-star-fellowship (EPA ended STAR fellowships in 2015); asf-postdoc (no longer in ASF current funding list); aahpm-research-grant (AAHPM no longer offers its own research grant); ge-healthcare-iir (no public investigator-initiated program page); nih-mosaic-k99 (NIGMS MOSAIC pages removed; program not current); nih-diversity-supplement (NIGMS page removed; PA-23-189 expired May 2026).

schema.title: Full grant name

grants.title: UCSF RAP Pilot Grant for Early Career Investigators
grants.stage_notes: Explicitly open to residents and fellows as PI; multiple agency sponsors per cycle; UCSF-only
grants.eligibility: UCSF residents and fellows as PI; pilot/seed funding for early research projects
grants.deadline: Spring and Fall RAP cycles — verify at rap.ucsf.edu

grants.title: UCSF Anesthesia Clinical Seed Award
grants.org: UCSF Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care
grants.stage_notes: Clinical faculty at all career stages; suitable for those without substantial prior research experience
grants.eligibility: UCSF Anesthesia faculty; supports clinical research involving human subjects, human samples, or human-derived data; iterative mentorship provided
grants.deadline: Annual internal cycle — contact UCSF Anesthesia research administration

grants.title: NBME Stemmler Grant Program
grants.stage_notes: Medical education researchers/teams; faculty-led; assessment/evaluation focus
grants.eligibility: Medical education researchers and teams; faculty-led projects in assessment and evaluation of medical competence

grants.title: NBME Emerging Innovators Grant
grants.stage_notes: Emerging researchers in medical education assessment
grants.eligibility: Emerging medical education assessment researchers; team-based applications; innovating in assessment methods
grants.deadline: 2026 applications announced (verify current deadline at NBME.org)

grants.title: Josiah Macy Jr. Foundation Catalyst Awards for GME Transformation
grants.stage_notes: GME programs and institutions; team-based institutional applications
grants.eligibility: GME programs and institutions; projects affecting how residents/fellows are trained; team-based applications
grants.deadline: Not listed on the redesigned Macy site; verify the program is still offered

grants.title: Macy Faculty Scholars Program
grants.amount_label: Substantial salary + project support (verify current RFA)
grants.stage_notes: Mid-career health professions educators; institutional nomination required
grants.eligibility: Faculty at accredited US nursing or medical schools; assistant or early associate professor (3-8 years); dean nomination required (one per institution); US citizen or permanent resident.
grants.deadline: Annual: portal opens ~May, due ~late July (2027 cohort closed; next call ~May 2027)

grants.title: Society for Simulation in Healthcare Discovery Award
grants.stage_notes: Simulation researchers; SSH membership required
grants.eligibility: Simulation researchers; SSH membership and eligibility requirements vary by call
grants.deadline: Annual (2026 call announced — verify at ssih.org)

grants.title: AHRQ K08: Mentored Clinical Scientist Research Career Development Award
grants.org: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
grants.stage_notes: Clinical doctoral degree holders developing health services research careers
grants.eligibility: Clinical doctoral degree holders developing health services research careers; US citizen or PR; protected time and mentorship required
grants.deadline: Standard AHRQ/NIH K deadlines (verify current NOFO at AHRQ.gov)

grants.title: NIBIB Trailblazer Award for New and Early Stage Investigators (R21)
grants.org: NIH / National Institute of Biomedical Imaging and Bioengineering
grants.stage_notes: New and early-stage investigators (ESIs); PI must meet NIH ESI criteria
grants.eligibility: New or early-stage investigators (NIH ESI criteria); biomedical engineering or imaging technology research; no significant prior R01-equivalent funding
grants.deadline: Last NOFO (PA-25-169) expired; check NIBIB for the reissued announcement

grants.title: Medtronic External Research Program (ERP)
grants.amount_label: Funding and/or product support (negotiated per protocol)
grants.stage_notes: Investigator-sponsored; sponsor-investigator/institution leads; must align with Medtronic products/therapies
grants.eligibility: Investigators and institutions; research must align with Medtronic product portfolio and active areas of interest; rolling concept submission

grants.title: Abbott Cardiovascular Investigator Sponsored Studies Program
grants.amount_label: Funding and/or device support (varies by study)
grants.stage_notes: Investigator-sponsored; cardiovascular device product alignment required
grants.eligibility: Investigators and institutions; must align with Abbott cardiovascular product areas; rolling submission

grants.title: Stryker Investigator-Initiated Studies Program
grants.stage_notes: Original clinical research in mutually beneficial therapeutic areas
grants.eligibility: Investigators proposing original clinical research aligned with Stryker product therapeutic areas

grants.title: Gilead Research Scholars Program
grants.amount_label: Substantial multi-year support (verify current disease-area RFA)
grants.stage_notes: Early-career faculty; disease-area specific (HIV, HCV, oncology, etc.); citizenship/appointment requirements vary
grants.eligibility: Early-career faculty/investigators; disease-area specific annual calls; research must align with Gilead therapeutic portfolio

grants.title: Takeda Investigator-Initiated Research Program
grants.amount_label: Drug supply and/or funding (varies by project)
grants.stage_notes: Investigators/institutions; alignment with Takeda therapeutic areas required
grants.eligibility: Investigators and institutions; must align with Takeda therapeutic area priorities (oncology, neuroscience, GI, rare disease)

grants.title: Intuitive Foundation Clinical Research & Education Support
grants.stage_notes: Minimally invasive and robotic surgery ecosystem; education and research focus
grants.eligibility: Institutions, educators, and researchers in the minimally invasive/robotic surgery ecosystem; eligibility varies by program

grants.title: Society for Technology in Anesthesia Research Grants and Awards
grants.amount_label: Small awards, travel, and research support (verify current)
grants.stage_notes: Investigators and trainees interested in anesthesia technology; STA membership encouraged
grants.eligibility: Investigators and trainees with interest in anesthesia technology; membership and meeting abstract requirements vary

grants.title: EAST Research Scholarship
grants.org: Eastern Association for the Surgery of Trauma
grants.stage_notes: Residents and fellows in surgery-related fields eligible; anesthesia/critical care fellows welcomed.
grants.eligibility: Fellows or junior faculty within 5 years of training completion. EAST member or become one.

grants.title: AAST Research Scholarships
grants.org: American Association for the Surgery of Trauma
grants.stage_notes: Designed for early-career investigators; awardees must attend AAST Annual Meeting.
grants.eligibility: Active training or within 5–7 years of fellowship/residency. AAST membership required.

grants.title: AAST SPRINT Mentored Research Scholarship
grants.org: American Association for the Surgery of Trauma
grants.stage_notes: Designed for trainees early in research careers; mentored award.
grants.eligibility: Residents and fellows in surgery, critical care, anesthesia, or emergency medicine. AAST member.

grants.title: SMFM Foundation / AAOGF Research Scholarship
grants.org: Society for Maternal-Fetal Medicine Foundation / AAOGF
grants.stage_notes: MFM fellows and early-faculty; relevant for anesthesiologists with OB focus.
grants.eligibility: MFM fellows or junior faculty within 3 years of training; academic career planned.

grants.title: Preeclampsia Foundation Vision Grant
grants.stage_notes: Seed funding for early investigators.
grants.eligibility: Fellows, postdocs, or early-career faculty; anesthesia, OB, cardiology, or basic science with preeclampsia focus.
grants.deadline: Annual, late May (May 27 last cycle); 2027 call not yet posted

grants.title: Preeclampsia Foundation Pappas Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Larger translational or clinical award; for established investigators with preliminary data.
grants.eligibility: Faculty-level investigators with relevant preliminary data.

grants.title: Children's Heart Foundation Discovery Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Seed funding for investigators studying congenital heart disease; relevant for pediatric cardiac anesthesiologists.
grants.eligibility: Researchers focused on congenital heart disease biology, outcomes, or perioperative care.

grants.title: NIH Fogarty International Center D43/D71 Global Health Training Grant
grants.stage_notes: D43 funds institutional programs; D71 funds individual fellows in global health research.
grants.eligibility: US investigators working in global health settings; strong fit for global surgery/anesthesia.
grants.deadline: Multiple cycles; check NIH Grants (PAR announcements)

grants.title: AAS Global Surgery Research Award
grants.stage_notes: Designed for trainees or early faculty conducting global surgery/anesthesia research.
grants.eligibility: Surgical or anesthesia trainees and junior faculty engaged in global surgery research. AAS membership required.

grants.title: ASRA Chronic Pain Research Grant
grants.org: American Society of Regional Anesthesia and Pain Medicine
grants.stage_notes: Distinct from Koller Grant; focused on chronic pain mechanisms and treatment.
grants.eligibility: Anesthesiologists or pain medicine specialists within 5 years of training; ASRA membership required.

grants.title: ASRA Early-Stage Investigator Award
grants.org: American Society of Regional Anesthesia and Pain Medicine
grants.stage_notes: Specifically targets investigators at the very start of their independent research career.
grants.eligibility: Within 3 years of completing fellowship/residency. ASRA membership required.

grants.title: Rita Allen Foundation / USASP Scholars in Pain Research Award
grants.org: Rita Allen Foundation / U.S. Association for the Study of Pain
grants.stage_notes: Within 3 years of starting tenure-track; must have startup funds and independent lab space. No indirect costs covered.
grants.eligibility: Early-career faculty who have recently established independent positions; broad pain research.

grants.title: IASP Collaborative Research Grant
grants.org: International Association for the Study of Pain
grants.stage_notes: Requires cross-country or international collaboration.
grants.eligibility: Investigators with an international collaborator; IASP member. Open to all career stages.

grants.title: IASP John J. Bonica Trainee Fellowship
grants.org: International Association for the Study of Pain
grants.stage_notes: Supports trainees attending IASP World Congress or visiting a pain research lab.
grants.eligibility: Medical or graduate trainees in pain-related field. IASP membership required.
grants.deadline: Check IASP website; varies by year

grants.title: Sleep Research Society Foundation Career Development Award
grants.stage_notes: For investigators early in independent sleep research career.
grants.eligibility: MD or PhD within 7 years of terminal degree or residency; SRS membership preferred.

grants.title: SCCM-Weil Research Grant and Discovery Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Named for Dr. Max Harry Weil; supports critical care science broadly.
grants.eligibility: SCCM Professional or Select Member. Weil: single-site studies. Discovery: multi-institutional (≥2 sites). Both completed within 12 months.

grants.title: SOCCA Young Investigator Award
grants.stage_notes: Seed grant for junior investigators in critical care anesthesiology.
grants.eligibility: Anesthesiologists with critical care focus; SOCCA member.

grants.title: AGS / NIDUS Pilot Award (Delirium Network)
grants.org: American Geriatrics Society / Network for Investigation of Delirium: Unifying Scientists
grants.stage_notes: Priority for delirium, POCD, and perioperative neurocognitive disorders. Highly relevant for anesthesia.
grants.eligibility: Junior investigators within 5 years of completing training; must have mentor. Research focus on delirium or perioperative cognitive disorders.

grants.title: American Delirium Society Borten Research Award
grants.stage_notes: Small pilot/seed grant; named for Dr. Borten.
grants.eligibility: Clinician-investigators with delirium research focus. ADS membership encouraged.

grants.title: PCORI Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Broad eligibility; relevant for clinical outcomes research in pain, palliative care, critical care, perioperative medicine.
grants.eligibility: Independent researchers; requires patient/stakeholder engagement. Open to all specialties.

grants.title: SNACC Michenfelder New Investigator Award / Young Neuroscience Research Award
grants.org: Society for Neuroscience in Anesthesiology and Critical Care
grants.stage_notes: Specifically supports neuroanesthesia and neurocritical care research.
grants.eligibility: Anesthesiologists or intensivists with neuroanesthesia or neurocritical care research focus. SNACC membership preferred. Includes the Michenfelder New Investigator Award and William L. Young Neuroscience Research Award.

grants.title: NCS Small Grants for Big Ideas / Technology Integration Grant
grants.amount_label: Varies by program; see NCS website
grants.stage_notes: Highly relevant for anesthesiologists entering neurocritical care; supports research training.
grants.eligibility: Neurocritical care investigators; NCS membership required. Current programs include Small Grants for Big Ideas and Technology Integration Grant (2-year, focused on practical technology development).

grants.title: RWJF Harold Amos Medical Faculty Development Program
grants.org: Robert Wood Johnson Foundation / Indiana University School of Medicine
grants.stage_notes: One of the most prestigious diversity faculty development awards in medicine.
grants.eligibility: Physicians from underrepresented groups who completed residency/fellowship within 5 years. US citizens or permanent residents. Any clinical/research focus. 2026 cohort anticipated after program transition.
grants.deadline: 2026 cohort anticipated; check amfdp.org (2025 cohort suspended)

grants.title: AAMC Herbert W. Nickens Faculty Fellowship
grants.stage_notes: Primarily a recognition award with modest funding; prestigious for career documentation.
grants.eligibility: URM faculty in US medical schools who demonstrate leadership in addressing educational inequities. Nominated by deans.

grants.title: Ford Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.org: Ford Foundation / National Academies of Sciences
grants.stage_notes: Research postdoctoral fellowship for scientists from underrepresented backgrounds.
grants.eligibility: Individuals from underrepresented groups pursuing research careers; US citizens or permanent residents. Includes MD/PhD trainees in research-focused postdocs.

grants.title: National Medical Association Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Supports Black/African-American physician investigators; broad focus including health equity and clinical research.
grants.eligibility: Black or African-American physicians or trainees conducting research. NMA membership required.

grants.title: NIH ORWH/BIRCWH K12 Award (Women's Health Research)
grants.org: NIH Office of Research on Women's Health / Building Interdisciplinary Research Careers in Women's Health
grants.stage_notes: Institutional K12 award; scholars apply to join their institution's BIRCWH program. Focused on women's health.
grants.eligibility: MD or PhD within 5 years of terminal degree; must join an NIH-funded BIRCWH program at their institution.
grants.deadline: Check your institution's BIRCWH program (many at UCSF)

grants.title: National Hispanic Medical Association Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Supports Hispanic/Latino physician investigators; broad research focus.
grants.eligibility: Hispanic/Latino physicians or trainees conducting research. NHMA membership encouraged.

grants.title: NIEHS K01 Mentored Research Scientist Development Award (Environmental Health)
grants.org: National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences
grants.stage_notes: Mentored career development award; requires a primary research focus on environmental health science.
grants.eligibility: Researchers within 10 years of terminal degree pursuing environmental health science. US citizens/permanent residents or visa holders.
grants.deadline: Feb 12, Jun 12, Oct 12 annually (standard NIH cycle)

grants.title: NIEHS R21 Exploratory / Developmental Research Grant
grants.org: National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences
grants.stage_notes: Exploratory/pilot funding; good entry point for environmental or climate-health research without extensive preliminary data.
grants.eligibility: Independent faculty; US citizens/permanent residents or visa holders. Any clinical or basic research with environmental health relevance.

grants.title: Health Effects Institute Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Focuses on air pollution, transportation emissions, and health effects. Primarily investigator-initiated.
grants.eligibility: Independent faculty. HEI funds research on health effects of air pollution and traffic-related exposures; anesthesia/pulmonary critical care fit well.

grants.title: Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Climate & Health Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: RWJF has funded climate-health intersection research; check current open calls on their website.
grants.eligibility: Researchers and public health practitioners working at the climate-health intersection, particularly equity-focused work.
grants.deadline: Check RWJF.org for current open calls

grants.title: American Thoracic Society Environmental Health Policy Award
grants.stage_notes: Supports junior investigators conducting research on environmental exposures and respiratory/critical care health.
grants.eligibility: ATS members within 5 years of training; research focus on environment and lung/critical care health.

grants.title: Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation Environmental Health Grant
grants.stage_notes: Targeted to environmental science with health implications; primarily invitation-based but some open calls.
grants.eligibility: Faculty-level investigators; primarily by invitation but check website for current open competitions.
grants.deadline: Check Moore Foundation website for open competitions

grants.title: American Foundation for Suicide Prevention Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Multiple tiers: pilot grants ($30K), standard research grants ($120K), and career development awards. Relevant for physician suicide research.
grants.eligibility: Investigators at any career stage with research focus on suicide, suicidal behavior, or related mental health. Particularly relevant for physician/healthcare worker focus.

grants.title: AMA Foundation Physician Wellness Grant
grants.stage_notes: Supports research or program development addressing physician burnout, mental health, and well-being in training.
grants.eligibility: Trainees and early-career physicians conducting research on physician wellness or burnout. AMA membership encouraged.

grants.title: ACGME Back to Bedside Grant
grants.org: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education
grants.stage_notes: Resident- and/or fellow-led teams; must be trainee-initiated projects.
grants.eligibility: Resident and fellow teams proposing innovative projects to strengthen the physician-patient relationship. Trainee-led; faculty mentor required.
grants.deadline: Annual cycle; check ACGME website for current RFP dates

grants.title: NIMH K23 / K08 Mentored Career Development Award (Mental Health Focus)
grants.stage_notes: K23 for patient-oriented research; K08 for laboratory or translational research. Mental health focus includes depression, anxiety, PTSD relevant to healthcare workers.
grants.eligibility: Clinician-scientists within 7–10 years of terminal degree. US citizens/permanent residents or visa holders. Mentored research in mental health.

grants.title: AHRQ K12 / KHS Institutional Career Development Award (Health Services)
grants.org: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
grants.stage_notes: AHRQ funds health services research; scholars apply through an institutional K12 program. Strong fit for outcomes, access, and disparities research.
grants.eligibility: MD or PhD within 5 years of terminal degree joining an AHRQ-funded institutional program. Research must address health services, outcomes, or quality.
grants.deadline: Check your institution's AHRQ K12 program for internal deadlines

grants.title: AHRQ R21 Exploratory Research Grant (Health Services)
grants.org: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
grants.stage_notes: Exploratory/developmental research; covers outcomes, quality, patient safety, disparities, and delivery science.
grants.eligibility: Independent researchers; US citizens/permanent residents or visa holders. Research must address healthcare delivery, quality, or outcomes.

grants.title: NIMHD Research Grant (Health Disparities Focus)
grants.org: National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities
grants.stage_notes: NIMHD funds R01, R21, K01, and career development awards focused on reducing health disparities. Anesthesia outcomes, pain disparities, and ICU disparities are relevant topics.
grants.eligibility: Investigators whose research addresses health disparities for minority or underserved populations. Any career stage; US or international.
grants.deadline: Standard NIH cycles (Feb, Jun, Oct); check specific PA

grants.title: NIMHD Loan Repayment Program for Health Disparities Research
grants.org: National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities
grants.stage_notes: Dedicated health disparities track within NIH Loan Repayment Program; must conduct health disparities research as primary focus.
grants.eligibility: Clinician-researchers or PhD scientists with >$20,000 educational debt conducting health disparities research at a nonprofit or government institution.

grants.title: Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Investigator Awards in Health Policy Research
grants.stage_notes: Prestigious award for researchers working at the intersection of health services, policy, and equity.
grants.eligibility: Independent researchers focused on health policy, services, or disparities. Strong preference for equity-oriented work.
grants.deadline: Check RWJF website for current cycle

grants.title: Greenwall Faculty Scholars Program in Bioethics
grants.stage_notes: Within 8 years of faculty appointment; not yet tenured or equivalent. 50% research effort required. ~3 scholars selected annually.
grants.eligibility: Early-career faculty (within 8 years of appointment) with research focus on clinical bioethics, health policy, or justice in medicine.
grants.deadline: RFP typically posts July annually; 2026-2027 cycle opens Summer 2026

grants.title: AHA Health Equity Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: AHA has dedicated equity-focused funding; relevant for anesthesiologists studying cardiac outcomes disparities.
grants.eligibility: Researchers studying disparities in cardiovascular or stroke outcomes; AHA membership encouraged.

grants.title: Society of General Internal Medicine (SGIM) Health Disparities Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Small grant for health disparities or health services research; open beyond GIM to any clinician researcher.
grants.eligibility: Clinician-investigators within 5 years of training with focus on health equity or disparities. SGIM membership required.

grants.title: AHA Strategically Focused Research Network — Clinical Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Multi-site network grants; relevant for large clinical trials, outcomes, and disparities research in cardiovascular and perioperative medicine.
grants.eligibility: Independent investigators; must propose a collaborative research network. Anesthesia/perioperative cardiovascular research qualifies.

grants.title: SCCM Discovery Research Grant
grants.stage_notes: Multi-institutional collaboration required (minimum 2 sites); preference for early-career investigator involvement.
grants.eligibility: SCCM Professional or Select Member. Must propose multi-institutional study completed within 12 months.

grants.title: ABA/FAER Research in Education Grant
grants.org: American Board of Anesthesiology / Foundation for Anesthesia Education and Research
grants.stage_notes: Academic anesthesiology faculty; ABA/FAER partnership grant focused on education research
grants.eligibility: Academic anesthesiology faculty with education research focus; ABA/FAER partnership; verify current cycle — not offered every year
grants.deadline: Not active this cycle (verify next FAER announcement)

grants.title: FAER Transition to Independence Grant
grants.org: Foundation for Anesthesia Education and Research
grants.stage_notes: Designed for investigators who have completed a FAER MRTG and are transitioning to independent funding
grants.eligibility: Anesthesiologists who have completed a FAER Mentored Research Training Grant (MRTG) and are pursuing independent research funding
grants.deadline: Verify with FAER (not offered every cycle)

grants.title: PhRMA Foundation Faculty Starter Grants
grants.stage_notes: New independent faculty in pharmacology, pharmaceutics, or pharmacoeconomics/outcomes research; typically within first 3 years of appointment
grants.eligibility: Full-time, promotion-eligible faculty at PhD-granting US universities; faculty appointment must have begun Jan 1, 2025 or later; terminal degree conferred Jan 1, 2017 or later; minimum 3 first-author publications; cannot be PI on NIH R/K series or NSF CAREER awards. Research areas: Drug Discovery, Drug Delivery, Translational Medicine, Value Assessment & Health Outcomes Research
grants.deadline: Check PhRMA Foundation website (typically spring cycle)

grants.title: Doris Duke Clinical Scientist Development Award
grants.stage_notes: MD or MD-PhD physician-scientists in early independent faculty phase; no open opportunities at this time
grants.eligibility: Early-career MD or MD-PhD physician-scientists within first 6 years of faculty appointment; strong clinical research focus required. No open opportunities currently — check DDCF website for next cycle.
grants.deadline: No open opportunities (check ddcf.org for next cycle)

grants.title: Parker B. Francis Fellowship Program
grants.stage_notes: Research fellows and early faculty in pulmonary, critical care, or sleep medicine
grants.eligibility: Physician or PhD investigators (MD, PhD, etc.) in pulmonary, critical care, or sleep medicine; US or Canadian citizen/permanent resident; within 7 years of completing doctorate or clinical training; minimum 75% time available for research; cannot be PI on NIH K or R series awards

grants.title: ABMS Research and Education Foundation Independent Research Grant
grants.org: American Board of Medical Specialties Research and Education Foundation
grants.stage_notes: Open to faculty at any stage at US institutions; focus on board certification, assessment, and quality of care research
grants.eligibility: PI must be at a US institution; cannot be affiliated with ABMS or any ABMS Member Board. Open to health systems, universities, or organizations whose mission aligns with ABMS. 4 awards per cycle.
grants.deadline: Opens mid-November 2026; LOI Jan 29, 2027; full proposal May 3, 2027

grants.title: SAEM Foundation Education Research Training Grant
grants.org: Society for Academic Emergency Medicine Foundation
grants.stage_notes: Within 8 years of completing initial residency; must have EM or pediatric EM faculty appointment
grants.eligibility: MD/DO/PhD with faculty appointment in emergency medicine or pediatric EM; SAEM member in good standing; within 8 years of completing initial residency; early-stage investigator with no prior SAEMF education grant

grants.title: AAMC Group on Educational Affairs National Research Grant
grants.org: Association of American Medical Colleges — Group on Educational Affairs
grants.stage_notes: Open to any medical educator at AAMC-member institutions; regional GEA variants (NEGEA, SGEA, CGEA, WGEA) offer similar small grants
grants.eligibility: Medical educators at AAMC-member institutions; research addressing medical education problems (professional identity, learner well-being, faculty development, competency-based education, IPE). Regional GEA chapters offer parallel grants up to $15,000.
grants.deadline: Fall pre-proposal, spring full proposal (verify aamc.org/gea for current cycle)
